snippet.title: Relooted Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Is it stealing to take back what was stolen? The time has come for you to find out. Relooted is officially available.

Heist and reclaim real African artifacts from museums and private collections around the world in this Africanfuturist heist game. Recruit crew members, plan escape routes, acquire the precious cargo, and bounce out of the joint as fast as you can.

⏰  Pull off heists: Plan and prepare your escape route by solving puzzles and placing teammates in the right place. When you’re ready, take the artifact and escape with Nomali’s flow-based parkour abilities.

👥  Recruit a crew: Meet and and gradually recruit different team members with their unique abilities.

📍 Explore an Africanfuturist setting: With a Hideout based in South Africa, you’ll see parts of Johannesburg imagined in the future.

🖼️ Reclaim Real Artifacts: Recover 70 artifacts that exist in real-life, all of which are of huge cultural, historical, and spiritual significance to the people they were taken from.

Purchase Relooted today on:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3255890/Relooted/

The Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/relooted-89fdd7

Xbox Play Anywhere & Xbox Game Pass: https://www.xbox.com/en-za/games/store/relooted/9ppp5344b3ls

The heist awaits… are you ready?

More about Relooted:
Africanfutur-heist:
Near the end of the 21st century, the political powers that brokered a Transatlantic Returns Treaty, promising the repatriation of African artifacts from museums. Good old fashioned diplomacy was working… until it wasn’t. An amendment switched up the terms and conditions of which objects were to be returned. Museums, now knowing that only publicly displayed artifacts would be given back, were slowly removing artifacts from public display.

You’ve got 70 of these artifacts to reclaim, all of which exist in real-life and are of huge cultural, historical, and spiritual significance to the people they were taken from.

Teamwork Makes The Heist Work
It all starts with a troublesome little brother who, yeah, gets you into all sorts of messes. But thankfully, as Nomali, you’ll meet more reliable crew members from different African countries. Recruit people from the classic hacker to… your prim and proper grandma? Don’t worry, grandma pulls her weight.

Case the Joint
Plan ahead to lay the groundwork for a beautiful masterpiece of an escape. You’ll be using the latest Africanfuturist technology to scope a museum. Check the getaway route, fiddle with puzzles and obstacles, and find spots to optimise the help of the right teammates. 

Get In. Get Out.
Once you’ve set the stage carefully and the artifact is sitting all pretty (looking quite not-stolen, but no worries, you’re gonna fix that ASAP), this is the moment to perform. Plucking an artifact from its resting spot triggers the alarm, and with Nomali’s flow-based parkour abilities, escaping should feel like you’re in the fun, montage part of a heist movie. But if you slacked on the planning phase, you’re gonna pay for it!
